g.title: MarieRank4Convo2 begins.
g.text: MarieRank4Convo2 begins.

g.title: j3577437779
g.text: Check boolean DrifterFaithStop

g.title: j1799785492
g.text: Drifter ! Bonjour ! I have discovered something most incredible, and I must tell you about it.

g.title: j3577437779->j1799785492
g.text: true

g.title: j2985108024
g.text: Marie, may I ask a personal question?

g.title: j3577437779->j2985108024
g.text: false

g.title: j1872423790
g.text: Why do you choose to worship Sol?

g.title: j3577437779->j1872423790
g.text: false

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j3577437779->j242691715
g.text: false

g.title: j259689191
g.text: Oh?

g.title: j2961397627
g.text: Check boolean DrifterMarie

g.title: j2563733639
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j2679105980
g.text: Oui ! Did you know that when I am fully in flight, I am impossible à voir ?! Je suis invisible !

g.title: j2128463269
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2961397627->j2128463269
g.text: true

g.title: j186264682
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2961397627->j186264682
g.text: false

g.title: j2968616032
g.text: You told me you have a faith similar to mine, non ? Why do you believe ?

g.title: j2563733639->j2968616032
g.text: DrifterFaithYesSimilar

g.title: j3493496200
g.text: You told me you have a faith, though it was different from mine, it was faith all the same. Why do you believe ?

g.title: j2563733639->j3493496200
g.text: DrifterFaithYesForeign

g.title: j1820692769
g.text: I know you said your faith is personal to you, much like une histoire of your own making, but it is faith all the same. Why do you believe ?

g.title: j2563733639->j1820692769
g.text: DrifterFaithPersonal

g.title: j1488926391
g.text: Why do you ?

g.title: j2563733639->j1488926391
g.text: DrifterFaithSol

g.title: j832281644
g.text: I could ask you the same of Lua, non ? Why do you believe ?

g.title: j2563733639->j832281644
g.text: DrifterFaithLua

g.title: j86687863
g.text: Why Sol, in particular ? Over Lua or perhaps the balance you adhere to ? A very good question. Why do you believe ?

g.title: j2563733639->j86687863
g.text: DrifterFaithBalance

g.title: j1944889651
g.text: What gives me my certainty, you wonder ? Where you say we cannot know the universe ?

g.title: j2563733639->j1944889651
g.text: DrifterFaithAgnostic

g.title: j2984690083
g.text: As someone who follows no faith, I could see why that could seem strange, oui.

g.title: j2563733639->j2984690083
g.text: DrifterFaithNoFear

g.title: j2563733639->j2984690083
g.text: DrifterFaithNoMaybe

g.title: j2563733639->j2984690083
g.text: DrifterFaithNoMITW

g.title: j1181729799
g.text: What gives me my certainty, you wonder ?

g.title: j2563733639->j1181729799
g.text: false

g.title: j1290213908
g.text: Do you know what this means ?!

g.title: j2894622072
g.text: Oui ! I am unfond of cut flowers. If you wish to get me a gift, I pray it will not be roses in a vase.

g.title: j3648719684
g.text: Pour toi ? Bien sûr.

g.title: j1491170426
g.text: I... suppose I feel obligated to.

g.title: j2751518712
g.text: I wasn't really being honest with you when I told you that answer.

g.title: j2405127115
g.text: I had an experience. It changed my life.

g.title: j3483795578
g.text: Nothing ever happened, it's just something I've felt. It's guided me.

g.title: j2741777757
g.text: I want to believe. Therefore, I do.

g.title: j1749588406
g.text: I fear my answer may disappoint you, wolf. There has been no great miracle. No rays from the skies that shone down upon me.

g.title: j3588806134
g.text: "Why does this sensible young woman believe in things that I do not think are real, that seems silly," non ?

g.title: j1414080862
g.text: No?

g.title: j1459702966
g.text: Should I be worried?

g.title: j1167775302
g.text: How did you guess that was what I was going to ask? That's amazing.

g.title: j1744236198
g.text: That... wasn't what I was going to ask, but I will keep it in mind, thank you!

g.title: j3395692458
g.text: Why do you believe in Sol?

g.title: j3222404579
g.text: Check boolean DrifterFaithNoPeace

g.title: j3069275248
g.text: Oui ? I am curious, why did you lie ?

g.title: j1998657205
g.text: Then I am jealous ! Most are not so lucky to have an event they can point to that is so ferme, oui ?

g.title: j3192997485
g.text: Ah, then our answers are the same. I have never known un miracle, save perhaps le Cardinal's arrival to the Cathédrale.

g.title: j3080931226
g.text: Check boolean DrifterFaithNoPeace

g.title: j311053975
g.text: Non, I have always simply felt as though there has been a présence in my life that has been there to guide me. A benefactor that smiles and points when I reach the crossroads, nothing more.

g.title: j4120573018
g.text: Honestly? Yes, kind of. I didn't want to phrase it that way, though.

g.title: j3076087467
g.text: I was more wondering if there was an event, or... a moment that led to it.

g.title: j1014039410
g.text: Neither do I ! But the possibilities are now endless !

g.title: j2383086557
g.text: Peut-être ! Because the possibilities are now endless !

g.title: j2787571972
g.text: Because the devil told me you were going to.

g.title: j470421604
g.text: Oh ! Oh, forgive me ! I am sorry. What is it that you wished to ask ? Et maintenant, je suis mortifiée...

g.title: j1522583518
g.text: And you say it does not bring you much peace... this breaks my heart.

g.title: j3222404579->j1522583518
g.text: true

g.title: j2235489945
g.text: I will not tell you what to do. And I will not tell you what roads to seek.

g.title: j3222404579->j2235489945
g.text: false

g.title: j715188189
g.text: I'm not sure, to be blunt. It was impulsive.

g.title: j4182171338
g.text: I thought it might be a way to get to know you better...

g.title: j2316191574
g.text: But your question was about why I believe, and I was quite rude in turning it about-face, je m'excuse.

g.title: j974053803
g.text: Even then, that was an act of man and science, not the Luminaries, non ? This sérum that gave me the gift of flight -

g.title: j730460336
g.text: But you say it does not bring you much peace ? This breaks my heart...

g.title: j3080931226->j730460336
g.text: true

g.title: j3260647970
g.text: I think your faith may be the strongest of them all, non ?

g.title: j3080931226->j3260647970
g.text: false

g.title: j1335180133
g.text: You wouldn't call Entrati's serum a miracle?

g.title: j43972062
g.text: Not even Lyon's voices? Or the Indifference?

g.title: j3565299110
g.text: Oh, thinking me silly for believing in the Luminaries is one of the most polite things you can think about someone with a differing faith.

g.title: j168221506
g.text: The devil should be very afraid ! Beware, evil one ! The light shall smite thee from above !

g.title: j3920130825
g.text: Non, non, non... You were not going to ask me that, were you ? Ah !! Je vais lui faire bouffer un de ces livres !

g.title: j12293755
g.text: For I am a poor shelter in this Void storm in which you have found yourself.

g.title: j4122086375
g.text: I do not know what instinct drove you to tell me such things. But I am glad you have spoken the truth, now.

g.title: j1688026252
g.text: Oh... you did not need to tell me such things to know me.

g.title: j1013316544
g.text: It is the product of a man. But I believe that it was Sol who guided our roads to come together as one.

g.title: j412642102
g.text: It sounds to me as though you wander in the woods, desperately seeking a trail that you wish to be there.

g.title: j3804212007
g.text: To walk the trail in the woods simply with the hope in your heart to lead the way ?

g.title: j321422213
g.text: It could be, I do not know. Perhaps the devil is right, and they it is all product of science we do not yet understand. The two are not exclusive, non ?

g.title: j2714853330
g.text: It offends me none, and I am glad for your honesty, always.

g.title: j2718912295
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j1595618664
g.text: What is it that you wished to ask ? Et maintenant, je suis mortifiée...

g.title: j2985654076
g.text: But I wonder if you do not find yourself upon a crossroads, and you may wish to think upon which way to go, non ?

g.title: j4227456462
g.text: A soul is more than the faith they wear. I am une Sœur de Sol, but I would hope you see more than that in me, non ?

g.title: j193367720
g.text: That is why I believe. I feel Sol beside me when I arrive at the places when I am most unsure. I shut my eyes et il est là, to guide me.

g.title: j1655098512
g.text: I do not know if you will ever find it, but I pray that you will. For what you might discover there will be un miracle.

g.title: j4019505315
g.text: That is beautiful...

g.title: j3199134152
g.text: Sainte Mère Sol, vous avez béni votre fille aujourd'hui ! HA-HA !!

g.title: j2207810341
g.text: Obligation is no reason to believe. It only breeds doubt at best, and hollow contempt at worst.

g.title: j4105745275
g.text: There are as many topics that we could choose as there are stars in the sky !

g.title: j2721145728
g.text: That's beautiful.

g.title: j3763697755
g.text: Has he ever failed to guide you?

g.title: j2068854172
g.text: I wish I had that...

g.title: j2674019716
g.text: Faith should be a balm to the soul. Not a crutch nor an excuse.

g.title: j893508083
g.text: Do you forgive me, then?

g.title: j841858375
g.text: I'm sorry. It was a silly thing to do.

g.title: j3457116991
g.text: Oui, and I know I am lucky. And it is a peace that is easy to seek to impose upon others, whether or not they want to have it.

g.title: j1700397705
g.text: Oui, many times. And in those moments, I reflect upon why. Perhaps I am meant to simply find my own way, non ? Ou peut-être que je suis une folle après tout, hah ! We are not always meant to know.

g.title: j2810145478
g.text: Oui, and I pray that you will have it some day. But it is not something that can be given or taught, it is something that must be found.

g.title: j3009012860
g.text: Boolean DrifterCrossroads is now true.

g.title: j4082381856
g.text: Oui, I forgive you. If you were like Lyon, I would tell you ten lashes was your payment.

g.title: j149898595
g.text: Oui, and if you were like Lyon, I would tell you ten lashes was your payment ! But you are not. And you are forgiven.

g.title: j413263389
g.text: But as long as I am harming no one with my beliefs, I see no harm in holding them, oui ?

g.title: j143353526
g.text: Within or without, where it may lay is different for everyone.

g.title: j1398195734
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithBalance is now false.

g.title: j1341978780
g.text: One thing has become clear to me though as of late.

g.title: j945396843
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithYesForeign is now false.

g.title: j2837999324
g.text: What?

g.title: j3005024914
g.text: Oh?

g.title: j1116270187
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithYesSimilar is now false.

g.title: j1844471690
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j1697729097
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithSol is now false.

g.title: j1914082105
g.text: I am growing to also have faith in you.

g.title: j3816308296
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithPersonal is now false.

g.title: j2979249757
g.text: Fie ! I must go. The devil is eager to use this contraption. À la revoyure !

g.title: j461955229
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithLua is now false.
